title: Finding register file: architecture
description: One register file docs/findings/register/architecture/<ID>.json holds a minor finding measured against a quality scenario. The contract is interface-contracts.md, register file. The schema uses no oneOf, because schema-validate supports none, so finding-lint checks the rules that tie waived to the override keys.

id.description: The ID that next-id printed. The file name is <id>.json.

source.description: The review or session that found the finding.

review_class.description: The class of the register folder.

type.description: A type from the vocabulary of the class.

story.description: The story ID the review ran for, or null when no story exists yet.

finding.description: What is wrong and the fix, as plain text.

importance.description: The importance of the threatened quality scenario. Priority 1 in arc42 section 10.2 is high, priority 2 is medium.

exposure.description: fails when the analysis shows the decision cannot meet the response measure of the scenario; uncertain when no evidence exists either way.

in_use.description: true when something built from the decision is in use. It raises a major risk to critical.

basis.description: The basis of the architecture class, as docs/spec/schemas/finding-basis.json defines it.

commit.description: The reviewed commit as 40 hexadecimal characters.

override_by.description: Human field. The stakeholder who lowered or waived the finding.

override_reason.description: Human field. Why the stakeholder lowered or waived the finding.
